company_info.company_description: "We are building a sustainable energy future.Our aim is to make the process of going solar as easy and seamless as possible. We offer the highest quality products and employ only in-house, SAA approved and registered installers so you can be assured everything is done right.We offer a one- stop solution, providing only tier-one (the best) panels and inverters to fit your needs and budget – both for commercial and residential properties.Shining Solar is committed to customer service and we will assist you in any way we can after installation has taken place."

reviews.review_description: The sales process was responsive without being pushy.The installation was timely and neatSmall hiccup with placement of isolation switch was corrected quickly.I'd use the same supplier and installer again.I've given the quality of the system 5 stars, but really won't know for several years.

Overall, very positive experience with Shining Solar. They provided responsive and friendly service, competitive pricing, and quick and professional install. They didn't conduct a site inspection prior to install and the final configuration was changed by the installer on the day, otherwise no issues. Yet to see what the actual yield is.

Shining Solar were a pleasure to deal with from the first phone call through to commissioning.The regulatory changes associated with the solar backstop is provoing to be difficult as my meter is yet to be configured a month after commissioning.

From the sales service right through to the post installation support, the Shining Solar team have been excellent. Prins was extremely helpful and friendly to deal with, at no point did I feel he was being pushy, he was just interested in a good outcome for the customer. The install itself was seamless too, a very professional and efficient team. The independent electrician who came later to verify the job (standard practice) mentioned that Shining Solar are known for doing quality installs. I would certainly recommend them, for price, quality and customer service.
Yes arrived on time, work was neat. Helpful staff would recommend to others.

Sales/quoting process is smooth and easy.installer are friendly and polite, it was a rainy day so it makes more mess than a normal installation would.Customer service is good too as they assisted with application and connected up with united energy, except there was some hiccup with the account and apps with the vendor.I do believe there could be some improvements or demo against the apps and usage of equipment.
Sales and install personal were extremely professional, knowledgeable and friendly

Shining Solar was one of the three quotes I received. They are the most local to me of the three and the pricing was comparable to another so the choice was easy.Jim is very personable and easy to chat to on the phone. And extremely patient as I had let the quote go for a number of months. After being asked to review the quote. Not only did Jim honour it he even slightly beat it.The whole process regarding the paperwork was smooth and painless and progressed with little input or followup, basically automatic all the way from applying for the rebate and loans all the way to grid connection. Jim will tell you what you need to do.Installation looks professional and tidy and I barely knew the installers were even working until they told me the work was finished and they were leaving.Jim even sent a gift card for referring a family member to them for their solar installation. I will continue to recommend Shining Solar to anyone that is interested in installing a solar system.

Sales/qouting process was prompt and competitive with pricing.Installation was Ok and tidy had to wait a few extra weeks to get it scheduled but it was punctually installed on the day it was scheduled. Could have been better if the boys would have told me how to connect the inverter to the wifi etc. but i have figured it out.Customer service is reasonably good for grid connection etc.

Their quote was competitive. Without asking I was provide two prices, a budget system and a premium system. They gave honest advice, and an on-site inspection. They installed when they said they would. A fuss free quality installation.  I'm very happy.

The quoting process ran well - everyone came back to me - one called me back and said they could even do better than their original quote...Installation went really well - they were here on time and very friendly and updated us on progress - they were also very accommodating as I'd changed my mind about something.Yes - they have contacted my energy supplier with the COES and other docs and my electricity company has been in touch with me to say they just now need to reconfig something at their end then I'm up and running.

Jim from Shining Solar was very helpful and keep us up to date.. The process was interesting but he helped us through it. Andrew and the install team were punctual friendly and very efficient .The inspector has already been and all is good.I would definitely recommend Shining Solar/ Jim and the team if you are looking for solar. He even let us know before we went ahead that there is No feed in tariff currently available in our area so unless we were home during the day solar was a financially sound investment at this time but as we are retired it was still a good idea for us as we use most our electricity during the day. So to Jim and the team -Job well Done.!! Regards Helen Cook

The sales process was easy and I received a quote quickly. The company seems to have a good range of products and was happy to adapt as needed to suit my requirements. The installation was delayed due to delays in the availability of products, but once booked went ahead quickly and professionally. I was broadly happy with customer service although it was a bit hard to get onto anyone after the install.

I recently had Shining Solar install solar panels in my home, and the experience was top-notch from start to finish!Professional Sales: The sales process with Shining Solar was exceptional. The sales team took the time to understand my budget constraints and provided a proposal that was not only optimized for cost but also included the best equipment available in that price range. Their professionalism and commitment to meeting customer needs stood out throughout the sales process.Fast Installation: I was amazed at how efficiently the Shining Solar team worked. 5 engineers showed up and started the installation in a highly organized manner. They completed the entire installation in just 4 hours! The speed and precision of their work were truly impressive.I highly recommend Shining Solar for their fast and efficient installation and their dedication to providing top-notch service. Kudos to the entire team!

Everything was smooth, price was great, components great, installers did a good job and left the place tidy. Only downside was that they made an error when submitting the meter reconfiguration request to my retailer which has caused me some minor hassle/delay with being able to export. Overall I am very satisfied and would not hesitate to recommend this group to friends and family.

Shining Solar Energy were one of three quotes referred from SolarQuotes.com.au.  Prins was the sales advisor and was extremely attentive and friendly, but not overly pushy.  He provided a quote the very next day and politely followed up to clarify the specs and ensure it met my energy needs.  The quote was the most competitive of the three I had received and I was able to make a few tweaks through several discussions with Prins to tailor it to my budget.  The solar guys arrived as planned at exactly 8am and carried about their business with installing the inverter and wiring, despite the wet weather.  They cleaned after themselves and unfortunately due to poor weather conditions had to return another day to install the panels.  The entire process was seamless and I was left completely satisfied with the service provided from sales to install and activation. Prins would always return my calls and emails.  I would not hesitate to recommend Shining Solar Energy to family and friends.

I found Manny was very easy to contact and talk to and answered all my questions (some before I even asked them). The installation team were great, punctual very tidy and quick. System was installed before lunch time. Josh went through the operation with me and the company organized the whole process of inspection and connection to grid.Thanks Shining Solar!
Shining Solar were great. Competitive price, clear and helpful in communications and a quick a painless installation processs

HiJim from shining solar was very helpful and the process was very easy .Jim helped with get the government rebates and got the best system for our needs .He organised the installation which was done in 6 hours and the team were friendly and helpful .
The team at Shining Solar were very professional and prompt in quoting, installation and post sales service. Very happy with the product.

We took our time and got 6 quotes. Settled on Shining Solar Energy after an excellent experience with Prins from the company. He allowed us to take our time, answered all queries promptly, helped us through the government subsidy/loan application and was not pushy. The system chosen had the longest warranty periods we found (25 years on the cells, 10 years on the invertor) and will accommodate possible future battery and a charger for an EV if required. The installation was done in a day by an excellent crew led by Andrew. Full clean up and no fuss. A professional process from start to finish and we are happy with the outcome.
Installation was very smooth, information clear, great experience so far.
Quick and easy install. Got it up and running quickly after inspection. Jim was a great sales person and easy to deal with. Grid connection was all done by shining solar.  Can't fault them.

Shining Solar were fantastic to work with. Jim was great, answering all our questions clearly, and giving us options. Jim also helped us through the rebate and post install connections with easy to follow instructions. Joshua and his team turned up on time, and worked quickly and efficiently to install the panels and inverter. Joshua was also happy to answer questions and explain the process. All up it was a smooth process and happy experience.

Jimmy s was great and very professional. Had no issues and for me in for an earlier appointment also so I wouldn’t wait as long. His boys were super professional and had it installed and running in no time.
The quote process was fast and the installation was done within a week.The installer was efficient and polite and explained the process.The grid connection had a few issues with Simply Energy.

I requested solar quote to supply quotes.Shining solar was the 1st to reply and their quote was within the expected price range.Shining Solar had site visit as well.I accepted the quote after the rebate was approved.No deposit requiredThey gave me an installation date which was in less than a month time.The installer arrived on the day and I found that they were an in-house technicians. Very familiar to the works needed to be done.In a few hours, the job is completed.I then pay the price as quoted.There were a few rain storms in the last few weeks, no leakage found from the roof.Perfect
The whole process was easy, installation was great, so tidy and careful. Can not fault them. Highly recommend.
Best price compared to the other vendors recommended by the team

From the quoting to the finished product, Shining Solar did an excellent job. Their customer service was very professional in all aspects. From Jim (Marketing and Sales) to the installation team, which was led by Andrew, they were very polite and informative. Apart from completing the paperwork in order to get the government grant, Shining Solar organised all other requirements. Highly commendable.

Shinning solar communicated very well and arranged a good installation. The installation was very good and they cleaned up after themselves. They assisted in organising the grid connection and included me in emails to my retailer to keep me abreast of progress.
Would recommend: honest and clear information, we’re able to remove old solar hot water panels.

Shining provided a solar solution that suited our roof configuration and was value for money versus others. Jim is easy to talk to and will seek answers from his technical people when required.  Andrew led the install and did a thorough job.

I was contacted promptly and quote was provided with various panel and inverter options. Good follow up on various questions I had. Once quote was accepted the installation was arranged promptly and on the day a very efficient team attended, job done within four hours with everything cleared away and new system ready for operation. Supplier coordinated with CEC and system was certified within a week. Very pleased with the outcome and would recommend this supplier.

Punctual quoting and response to followup questions. Also quick time from quote acceptance to installation. Installation looks professional and seems to be working well. Waiting to see the first bill to confirm.

The installation happened even earlier than we expected! We weren't given much notice, but it was terrific. All the companies who quoted seemed great, but at the lowest price Shining Solar did an excellent job and I would highly recommend them.
Service, price, installation… couldn’t fault them! Really good customer service and communication. Beat the price on another companies offer.

From start to finish I’ve been really happy with Shining Solar.  They’ve been really flexible and accommodated for my steep learning curve with lots of advice and many tweaks to the initial specification of the system.  The turnaround time from final quote to installation was excellent - especially given the weather in Melbourne at the moment.  Really impressed with these guys and would lent hesitate to recommend.

I recently install a 6.6kW solar system and had the best experience with Shining Solar. From the initial contact to answering some of dumb questions to accommodating changing design requirements, Jim was always patient, responsive and courteous.The installation team were punctual, completed the work and cleaned up all debris after the installation. They explained everything they were doing making me feel very comfortable.Once installed everything else was taken care of, very happy with the entire experience.

Jim made it easy and seamless. Shining Solar got me slotted me in time. They were also accommodating to my requirements. The guys who came to do the install were polite, put in the effort despite the intermittent rain and got it done. Even got the roof tile issues sorted. Happy that it's all sorted before the holiday season.

Great sales person. Really knew what he was talking about and listened to what I actually wanted and put togther a system that suited my needs and expectations.Then the installers that came to my house were very good. Polite, professional near and tidy and also listened to my wants and needs. I wanted certain things done and they were more then happy to do what I asked.Even when the inspector came to look over the system he acknowledged how good of an install it was.Once installed they took care of everything else to get it connected, I didn't have to do anything.The overall experience was just great and my system is performing exceptionally well so far, it has been on now for 2 months and record day so far have been 70.2kwh produced on a sunny day in October

Really easy to get a quote, which was tailored to suit what I wanted, at a very good price. Salesperson was not pushy at all. Installation was quick and very neat. System is working as expected. Would highly recommend.
Installer are polite and tidy.   Installation is very neat and performance of the system is great so far.
Very polite and professional. Arrived on time and took the time to answer my questions

Shinning Solar were excellent to deal with, "Manny" was extremely helpful and patient talking me through the process and explaining all aspects of the system.Installation Team were on time, polite and very courteous, very competitive price.

Sales person (Manny) was excellent to deal with, nothing seemed too much, also gave me a good deal when I upgraded the panels.  The crew who did the install were 2nd to none, they arrived before time, explained exactly what they were going to doing and on finishing did a clean up.Shinning Solar organised everything after the install for the grid connection. All I did was confirm with my provider my plan I was going onto. Very good experience with Shinning Solar.Thanks Solar quotes.

Communication from company positive and timely follow up.Quote easy to understand and information required by Solar Vic provided.All staff dealt with were positive and well informed.Installation date was set and all went as promised. Trades were on time, tidy, polite.Follow up inspection completed with a few days.Highly recommend.

They were happy to quote on several options, very well priced. I couldn’t fault the installation, The only thing that felt could have improved this experience would have been given some advice on the after installation process, as this really was not clear.
Fantastic sales team no gimmicks. quoting was quick. Andrew and his team arrived on time and were professional. Application to electricity supplier submitted by Shining Solar energy.

Manny was really helpful with quoting, and then adjusting quotes based on my questions and changes.Once I'd signed on to go with them I did have to follow up a few times to actually get install booked in, but it wasn't too bad.The install was really quick, and someone hung back to walk me through the system too.I did again have to follow up to get them to organise the inspector to come out, so that I could turn the system on and use it. But again, Manny was helpful when I reached out.The only other thing I'd note is that they don't pay anywhere near market rate for the STCs (like, 47% or so). But they explained that the install costs etc are generally much lower than most others, so that overall it works out. In my case it absolutely did. But just wanted to make note of that, in case anyone comes across this review after noticing the same thing!Lastly, my price paid after rebates includes an upfront payment of $1240, and the vic govt interest free loan - I've counted that, as its a loan not a rebate.
Manny was very Responsive and replied all emails, and the  team that installed were good tradesman, polite and worked hard and efficiently.
Good quoting process. The installer team was polite and tidy.

Sales manager very professional and helpful in lodging documents for Victorian Government  rebate and interest free loan. Installers were polite , broke no tiles and were finished soon after lunch. Inspector visited and passed the installation 7 days after installation . Pricing was very competitive so I am happy with how the process of getting solar for our house,

I am just so pleased with Shining Solar that I wanted to share my experience with anyone considering solar power. I have had such bad experiences with trades recently that it was wonderful to have such a good experience.Manny gave us our first quote and he was very pleasant and informative, but we shopped around a bit before we came back to him. His quote was competitive and he was always very easy to contact and clear about where the expenses were with an itemised quote, which many other companies refused to provide! This gave us confidence that we were paying an appropriate amount and it empowered us to chose which panels and inverter suited us because we knew the price difference between the different components. He was very patient and made many revisions of the components and panel layouts to fit with our preferences.Andrew came to perform a site visit and he impressed us with his calm, knowledgeable and "can-do" attitude. Similarly, when the panels were installed, Andrew returned with Joshua and 2 other fine young men (sorry I don't recall your names) who were all polite, clean and hardworking. I'm no expert but the work they have done looks neat and solid to me.I thoroughly endorse shining solar and in particular this team.

Work was performed over two separate days.  One was the installation of the inverter and the framework for the panels.  The other was panels and cabling.  All went well, and two panels needed optimisers which has not been planned for but were added at no extra cost.   Few tiles were broken but that is likely and understandable.  The only issue when the inspection came was some zinc spray had been missed but this was remedied the same day so full credit to them for handling this promptly and efficiently.  Their quote was similar to the others but their application showed a little more thought.  I up-specc'd the inverter from a Growatt to a Sungrow.  All in all I would recommend Shining Solar
Very competitive price. Great service. Installation team very flexible and friendly. Organised connection to the grid after installing.

Quote process was very professional and flawless. Company representative was extremely helpful and answered all questions promptly.Was kept well informed leading up installation. Day of installation was efficient and very professional. Only negative is having no assistance with setting up the monitoring application for the system to know it’s all working properly. Have still been unable to connect system to app, not through lack of trying. ( numerous YouTube videos and google searches)

Manny at Shining Solar from the first conversation I had with him was very informative, always available on the phone to answer many questions I had.In the end it was the best priced quote for a large solar system, we were also upgraded to better panels at no extra cost.From the book in date to installation it was seamless, very nice proffesional workmen cleaned up any mess they made.I highly recommend this company.CheersChrista
Good installer happy with work so far.
Manny was very nice to deal with, ended up refering 4 more properties to shining solar

Sales person was very supportive and clarified all my questions. Also provided best quote. Installation was very quick after rebate approval and installers are very professional. I'm still waiting for the inspection to approve and activate the solar system.

The whole process was stress free. Manny answered my many questions promptly and was readily contactable. The installers did a great job, were polite and professional and cleaned up and took away all mess from the install. I would highly recommend this company.

Manny was excellent in his sales information, assistance and quote details. He was knowledgeable and informative but never pushy and answered all of our queries.The Team of Installers arrived on time with all required tools and equipment.Their Vehicles were immaculately maintained inside and out and their work ethic was first class. My Wife and I found them to be polite and respectful.The job was finished on time with the small amount of mess created properly cleaned and taken away by them. At completion they explained the operations of the Solar Installation in understandable terms and left us with nothing more to organise. Could not fault this team who obviously enjoy and take pride in their work.Well done Shining Solar 10/10!!

Good service, James was nice and supportive, Installed Solar System on the agreed date without failure. Easy process (Rebate, Documentation etc) and value for money. Explained very well before the installation and was easy to deal with the them.Recommend their service.
Very prompt and reliable in timing of installation.  Sales person very easy to deal with and not pushy.  Provided various alternative systems as comparison.
